character: Geographical heart and nerve centre of the Méribel valley. Largest selection of restaurants, bars, and non-skiing activities. Parc Olympique (1992 Winter Olympics legacy) with 25m swimming pool, indoor ice rink, spa, climbing wall, fitness centre. Live music capital of the Alps — artists perform in bars, restaurants, auditorium. Dawson's Bar, Le Poste de Secours apres.
dining: Le Cookie's Club (1,650m, exposed beams, stone walls, terrace). Chez Kiki (open fire grilled meats, near Le Morel chair). Indian fare available. Le Cepe (Michelin-starred). La Fromagerie for Savoyard cheese. Glaciers bakery.
shopping: Boutiques, designer brands, interior design shops, La Fromagerie (Savoyard cheese), Glaciers bakery, Maison de la Presse (British newspapers), sports rental shops. Tuesday/Friday market on Route de la Chaudanne.
apres_scene: Dawson's Bar, Le Poste de Secours (iconic apres), Le Rond Point, Les Caves de la Loze. Live music capital of the Alps.
activities_nearby: Parc Olympique — 25m indoor pool, children's pool, water slide, fitness centre, climbing wall, spa, indoor ice rink. Snowshoeing at Altiport. Horse-sleigh tours, snowmobiling. Cinema. Bowling.
